desc: Implement A==B forced-arithmetic-progression check (congruence + AP/interval intersection).
Implement interval merging (adjacent L<=prev_r+1), the run-length>=B -> No rule, and good-segment extraction.
Implement the sliding-window DP (mask bit t = reachable(cur-t), RM=bits A-1..B-1, good vs bad transitions).
Implement saturation early-exit in long good runs (C0=A^2-A, THRESH=C0+B-1) and mask==0/FULL early returns.
Stress test vs brute force on small random inputs plus targeted edge cases; logic verified.
Confirm performance with N=1e12, M=2e4 (no per-cell simulation).
